Near Home.title: Heath & Hampstead Society: Hampstead Heath amid Progressing Climate Change – adaptation and protection

Climate change is already changing the wildlife and the landscapes of the Heath. This walk will reveal those changes and demonstrate how management of the Heath is being directed towards helping to address the impact of global warming. The meeting point is Parliament Hill Bandstand
